annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dyoub, A.; Costantini, S.; Letteri, I.
key_provisions_or_claims: Care robots can learn logical ethical rules from experience under a human ethical teacher.
Combines Answer Set Programming for representation with Inductive Logic Programming for rule learning.
Abstract medical ethics principles are hard to apply, so learning from cases is needed.
Illustrative care-home cases: taking insulin from another resident, and accompanying a resident during COVID-19.
ILP yields interpretable rules that can be analysed and adjusted.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Workshop paper showing how care robots can learn logical ethical rules of behaviour from experience under a human ethical teacher, using Answer Set Programming and Inductive Logic Programming, illustrated with care-home cases (insulin, COVID-19). It is a technical machine-ethics contribution, not a governance instrument.
annotation.title_clean: Care Robots Learning Rules of Ethical Behavior Under the Supervision of an Ethical Teacher
annotation.title_en: Care Robots Learning Rules of Ethical Behavior Under the Supervision of an Ethical Teacher
